source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Entry 897 describes an organizer listed as an attendee being treated as an unanswered invitation. The newer accepted checkAndSend path supplies the current user as invitedAttendee only when scheduling support identifies the item as an invitation. CalItipMessageSender documents invitedAttendee as null for outgoing invitations. Do not decide organizer-versus-invitee role only from attendee membership. This newer guard is accepted context, not a change made by entry 897, and the historical Bugzilla discussion remains unread.
title: Distinguish invitation role from merely appearing in the attendee list
